question: Should OpenClaw commit to a two-year HTTPS-only policy for every current and future `openclaw.ai` subdomain by merging `includeSubDomains` now?
rationale: This is a durable hosting and certificate-lifecycle commitment; source review cannot establish the complete DNS, certificate, and service inventory needed to make that decision safely.

options.title: Require readiness proof before merge
options.body: Document the active subdomain inventory and attach live response evidence for the intended global header after validating every covered hostname.

options.title: Scope HSTS to the apex first
options.body: Ship the two-year HSTS policy without `includeSubDomains` until the domain-wide HTTPS inventory is explicitly approved.

options.title: Pause the hardening change
options.body: Leave the current policy unchanged until ownership of every covered hostname and certificate lifecycle is clear.

recommendation.title: Require readiness proof before merge
recommendation.body: Document the active subdomain inventory and attach live response evidence for the intended global header after validating every covered hostname.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only maintainer-side actor visible in the current PR timeline and are best placed to confirm the public-domain inventory.
